pages: Orion Labs financial report FY2024. Total revenue for 2024 was $4,500,000. Operating profit was $900,000. Figures are in US dollars.
Orion Labs financial report FY2023 comparative figures. Total revenue in 2023 was $3,800,000. Operating profit was $620,000.
Archived Orion Labs report for FY2022. Revenue was $3,200,000. This is an older reporting year.
The financial year ends on December 31. Audit preparation begins in January.
Travel expense policy effective January 2025. Employees must submit expense claims within 30 days of completing travel. Receipts are mandatory for every hotel expense.
Travel policy: domestic hotel reimbursement is capped at $180 per night. International hotels require manager approval before booking.
Archived 2021 travel policy, no longer active. Expense claims had a 60-day submission deadline. The current policy replaces this deadline.
Archived hotel cap was $140 per night. This document must not be treated as the current travel policy.
Security incident response policy. Report a suspected security incident within 1 hour to the security team. Rotate affected credentials immediately.
Customer data backups are encrypted. Backup retention is 35 days, after which backup copies expire.
Enterprise support SLA. Priority 1 outages have a first-response target of 15 minutes. Priority 2 incidents have a first-response target of 4 hours.
Standard support operates Monday through Friday, 09:00 to 18:00 UTC. Enterprise Priority 1 coverage is available around the clock.
New hires complete security training within 7 days of their start date. Device encryption must be enabled before accessing customer systems.
Onboarding assigns a mentor on day one. The mentor schedules a check-in after two weeks.
Employees receive 20 days of annual leave per calendar year. Up to 5 unused days can be carried into the next year.
Parental leave requests go to the people operations team. This policy does not specify a parental leave duration.
Vendor contract termination requires 45 days of written notice. Material breach triggers a 10-day cure period before termination.
The vendor contract is governed by the agreed commercial terms. Annual contract value is $120,000.
The Atlas document export feature supports PDF and CSV. Exports can be requested from the Reports menu.
The Atlas product supports English and Spanish interfaces. Offline synchronization is not supported.
Disaster recovery objectives: recovery time objective is 4 hours. Recovery point objective is 1 hour.
Disaster recovery exercises run quarterly. The infrastructure team records the results and tracks remedial actions.
Purchases above $10,000 require finance approval and two vendor quotations. Purchases at or below $10,000 require manager approval.
Purchase orders must precede vendor invoicing. Invoices are normally paid within 30 days of receipt.
